newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Argentine officer to head U.N. Cyprus force.
newsitem.headline: Argentine officer to head U.N. Cyprus force.

text.p: Colonel Evergisto Arturo de Vergara of Argentina will be the new commander of the U.N. Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP) and will be promoted to the rank of major-general, the United Nations said Tuesday.
He will succeed Brigadier-General Ahti Toimi Paavali Vartiainen of Finland, who has headed the force since August 1994 and is relinquishing his post on Feb. 28.
The appointment was disclosed in an exchange of letters between Secretary-General Kofi Annan and Security Council president Hisashi Owada of Japan.
UNFICYP, one of the oldest U.N. field operations, was established in 1964 to help keep peace between the Greek Cypriot and Turkish Cypriot communities.
It now comprises about 1,160 troops and 35 civilian police from nine countries, including 390 soldiers from Argentina.
